decisions.briefing: Stocks slipped modestly today: the NASDAQ fell 0.9% and the S&P 500 fell 0.5%, so the market is neutral, not risk-off. Cash is $445.88, below the $500 buy threshold, so we are not forcing a new position even though 3 slots are open. All 7 holdings stay in place and the automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules keep managing them. If a strong risk-on day comes, the best candidates to buy are CBRS, FOUR, VKTX and FRPT, which have clean momentum setups with RSI under 70.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks drifted lower today. The tech-heavy NASDAQ lost 0.9%, more than the S&P 500's 0.5% drop, which suggests investors trimmed growth and tech names. Weakness in big chip and AI-infrastructure stocks such as NVDA, AMD, NBIS and CRWV, which are all trading below their 20-day averages, fits a cautious rotation rather than a broad sell-off. No specific news headlines were provided for today, so this explanation rests on price and technical data only.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日窄幅回落，以科技股為主的納指跌0.9%，跌幅大於標普500指數的0.5%，反映資金減持增長及科技板塊。NVDA、AMD、NBIS及CRWV等大型晶片及AI基建股均跌穿20日均線，走勢較像審慎的板塊輪動，而非全面拋售。由於今日未有提供具體新聞標題，以上分析只根據價格及技術數據。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is cash an investor keeps on hand to buy when a good opportunity appears. Today we held our small cash balance instead of spending it on a weak, slightly negative day. Waiting for a strong market day usually leads to better entry prices and more reliable trends.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「彈藥」（Dry Powder）是指投資者預留、準備在出現良好機會時入市的現金。今日大市輕微下跌、方向未明，我們選擇保留手上少量現金，而非勉強入市。耐心等待市場明顯轉強才出手，通常能取得較佳的入市價位，趨勢亦較可靠。
